name: Surescripts Network Analytics
description: Surescripts Health Information Network analytics for participants: one row per network transaction (NewRx, RxRenewal, CancelRx, RxChange, Medication History, Eligibility, Formulary, Prior Authorization, Clinical Direct Messaging) by prescriber organization, EHR vendor, state, PBM, pharmacy and therapeutic class, with response time, rejects and errors, Real-Time Prescription Benefit checks and patient savings, first-fill abandonment, EPCS and electronic prior authorization turnaround and approvals. Synthetic, non-PHI. Daily, Nov 2024 to Nov 2026.

columns.name: Transaction ID
columns.desc: Unique network transaction (message) ID.

columns.name: Transaction Date
columns.desc: Date the transaction crossed the Surescripts network.

columns.name: Region
columns.desc: US region of the prescriber site.

columns.name: State
columns.desc: US state of the prescriber site.

columns.name: Organization Type
columns.desc: Type of prescriber organization: health system, ambulatory clinic, specialty practice, LTPAC, urgent care.

columns.name: EHR Vendor
columns.desc: EHR or e-prescribing software the prescriber site uses.

columns.name: Prescriber Organization
columns.desc: Prescriber site (practice, clinic or health system) sending the transaction.

columns.name: Transaction Type
columns.desc: Network message type: NewRx, RxRenewal, CancelRx, RxChange, Medication History, Eligibility, Formulary, Prior Authorization, Clinical Direct Message.

columns.name: PBM
columns.desc: Pharmacy benefit manager covering the patient.

columns.name: Therapeutic Class
columns.desc: Drug class of the prescription or prior authorization.

columns.name: Specialty Medication
columns.desc: Yes when the drug is a specialty medication.

columns.name: Controlled Substance
columns.desc: Yes when the drug is a controlled substance (EPCS).

columns.name: Pharmacy
columns.desc: Pharmacy the prescription was routed to.

columns.name: PA Channel
columns.desc: How the prior authorization was submitted: Touchless ePA, Electronic (ePA) or Fax / Phone.

columns.name: PA Outcome
columns.desc: Prior authorization result: Approved, Denied, More Info Requested or Pending.

columns.name: Message Status
columns.desc: Delivered, Rejected (by the receiving system) or Error (network or format failure).

columns.name: New Prescriptions
columns.desc: NewRx e-prescriptions.

columns.name: EPCS Prescriptions
columns.desc: Electronic prescriptions for controlled substances.

columns.name: RTPB Checks
columns.desc: New prescriptions where the prescriber ran a Real-Time Prescription Benefit check.

columns.name: Alternatives Presented
columns.desc: RTPB responses that returned a lower-cost alternative.

columns.name: Alternatives Selected
columns.desc: Lower-cost alternatives the prescriber switched to.

columns.name: Patient Savings
columns.desc: Out-of-pocket savings for patients when a lower-cost alternative was chosen (USD).

columns.name: Patient Out-of-Pocket
columns.desc: Patient out-of-pocket cost on new prescriptions (USD).

columns.name: Abandoned Prescriptions
columns.desc: New prescriptions never picked up (first-fill abandonment).

columns.name: PA Requests
columns.desc: Prior authorization requests.

columns.name: PA Approvals
columns.desc: Prior authorizations approved.

columns.name: PA Decisions
columns.desc: Prior authorizations with a determination.

columns.name: PA Turnaround Hours
columns.desc: Hours from PA submission to determination.

columns.name: Days Pending
columns.desc: Days a pending prior authorization has been waiting.

columns.name: Response Time ms
columns.desc: Network round-trip response time in milliseconds.

columns.name: Rejected Messages
columns.desc: Messages rejected by the receiving system.

columns.name: Error Messages
columns.desc: Messages failed by a network or format error.

columns.name: Med History Matches
columns.desc: Medication history requests that returned a patient match.

columns.name: Transactions
columns.desc: Network transactions.

formulas.name: Reject Rate
formulas.desc: Share of transactions rejected by the receiving system.

formulas.name: Error Rate
formulas.desc: Share of transactions rejected or failed.

formulas.name: RTPB Adoption
formulas.desc: Share of new prescriptions with a Real-Time Prescription Benefit check.

formulas.name: Abandonment Rate
formulas.desc: Share of new prescriptions never picked up.

formulas.name: PA Approval Rate
formulas.desc: Approved share of decided prior authorizations.

formulas.name: ePA Share
formulas.expr: sum ( if ( [{T}::PA_CHANNEL] != 'Fax / Phone' and [{T}::PA_REQUESTS] = 1 ) then 1 else 0 ) / sum ( [{T}::PA_REQUESTS] )
formulas.desc: Share of prior authorizations submitted electronically (ePA or touchless).

formulas.name: EPCS Share
formulas.desc: Controlled-substance e-prescriptions as a share of new prescriptions.

formulas.name: Alternative Switch Rate
formulas.desc: Share of presented lower-cost alternatives the prescriber chose.
